reviews.text: They did an awesome job & completely remodeled my pool area! Replaced brick with flagstone. Replaced diving board with diving rock. Replaced old decking with stamped overlay in hand carved flagstone pattern. Replaced old plaster with lifetime pebble interior. I have used them previously & would highly recommend them. (see before & after pics)
reviews.author: michelle Cox

reviews.text:
Tom and his crews did a first class job renovating all aspects of my original 14yr old pool.
We replaced all the pool equipment and added a new Aqualink system, travertine coping, Cobalt glass mosaic tile, travertine paver decking, Crystal stone pebble finish and new LED lighting.
I couldn't be happier with the result.
reviews.author: USI Remodeling

reviews.text: Bought our house in 1995 with a 30,000 gallon pool and vinyl liner which Hartsell had installed. Lasted 15 years. Used him to install second liner. Lasted an unusually long time also. Getting ready to replace again and no brainer to use Hartsell. They do beautiful and precise work.
reviews.author: Yvonne Hutchings

reviews.text: Working with Tom was easy.  His pricing was very good.  He was very helpful in picking out our tile, deck and coping.  He was very easy to communicate with.  His crews were all polite.  It was a pleasure working with him.
reviews.author: Bill Matheu

reviews.text: Tom and his crews did an excellent job resurfacing our pool with Crystal Stones smooth pebble, repairing some leaks and replacing the mastic. Tom was always extremely responsive to my many questions. The pool looks great and we are thrilled!
reviews.author: rick rodgers

reviews.text: I had a resurface job done with Crystal Stone Pebble finish along with new tile and coping.  Tom Hartsell and his crew did an awesome job!  Everything looks great and there were no unexpected surprises or upselling pressures.  Tom is knowledgeable and easy to work with.  He answered all my questions and the price was very competitive too.  I highly recommend Hartsell Pool Renovations.  Thanks Tom!
reviews.author: David Sones

reviews.text: Tom and his crew did a fantastic job of remodeling our pool! Start to finish took just over a week.  Tom gave us a great bid and was responsive to any question I had through the process.  I highly recommend you give Hartsell Pools a look for your pool remodel.
reviews.author: Robert Stewart

reviews.text: I used Hartsell Pools for Pool & Spa Renovation:  The entire project was done in less than 4 weeks!  My old 80's spa was turned into a lovely tanning ledge with 3 fountains (his idea).  New tile, mastic, removal of heater, removal of diving board, cleaned up all their mess.  Tom Hartsell came onsite with the crew very regularly.  I was very pleased.  I got over 10 bids and he came in the lowest!  Apples to Apples with some!  He kept in constant contact with me, mostly by text but that was perfect for me.  But most importantly, my husband, the perfectionist, looked at EVERYTHING, from spa equipment that had to be dismantled to where diving board was and mastic and tile... PERFECT!  No, we're not related and I'm not getting paid for this.  My neighbor came over to see the pool; she was home every day watching the renovation.  She will be using Hartsell Pools.
reviews.author: Mary Bennett
